cards.example_en: The red carpet in the hall looks very old.
cards.example_zh: 大厅里的红地毯看上去非常旧了。

cards.example_en: The empty chair by the window is still warm.
cards.example_zh: 窗边那把空椅子还是暖的。

cards.example_en: Chew your food slowly during family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 家庭晚餐时要慢慢咀嚼食物。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：薯片；芯片
cards.example_en: He ate a bag of chips at lunch.
We hang lights on the tree at Christmas.
cards.example_zh: 圣诞节我们会在树上挂灯。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：电路；环形路线
cards.example_en: A broken circuit left the desk lamp dark.
cards.example_zh: 电路坏了，台灯就不亮了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：干净的
cards.example_en: His clean shirt was ready on the bed before the interview.
cards.example_zh: 面试前，他的干净衬衫已经放在床上。

cards.example_en: The concert will comprise three short songs and a dance.
cards.example_zh: 这场音乐会将包括三首短歌和一支舞蹈。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：当代的
cards.example_en: Contemporary dance was the highlight of the talent show.
cards.example_zh: 当代舞是才艺表演中最精彩的部分。

cards.example_en: Our county holds a big fair with races and homemade cakes.
cards.example_zh: 我们郡会举办大型集市，有比赛，也有自制蛋糕。

cards.example_en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
Spraying paint on the school wall is a crime, not a joke.
cards.example_zh: 往学校墙上喷漆是罪行，不是开玩笑。

cards.example_en: I opened the curtain and saw frost on the football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，看见足球场上结了一层霜。

cards.example_en: He washed cars all summer to clear the debt for his laptop.
cards.example_zh: 他洗了一夏天的车，才还清买笔记本电脑的债务。

cards.example_en: Each year group sent a delegate to plan the charity match.
cards.example_zh: 每个年级都派了一名代表去策划慈善比赛。
